scripts.build: pnpm run build:wasm && pnpm run build:js
scripts.build:js: tsup --config tsup.config.ts && cp -r pkg dist/ && rm -f dist/pkg/.gitignore
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm run build:wasm && forge build --root tests/fixtures/anvil && vitest run --config vitest.e2e.config.ts
scripts.test:e2e:sepolia-fork: pnpm run build:wasm && node --env-file-if-exists=../../.env node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.sepolia-fork.config.ts
scripts.example: wasm-pack build --target web --out-name index --out-dir pkg && forge build --root tests/fixtures/anvil && tsx examples/anvil.ts
